summary: Ansible 15 community.general removals: ansible-core 2.18 is no longer supported (needs 2.19.0+), the jboss module is removed (use the middleware_automation.wildfly.wildfly_app_deploy role), and keycloak_authentication, keycloak_authentication_required_actions, keycloak_authentication_v2 and keycloak_authz_authorization_scope are now redirects that need middleware_automation.keycloak installed.
questions: Which ansible-core does community.general need in Ansible 15?
Why does keycloak_authentication fail after upgrading to Ansible 15?

answer_card.title: Keycloak modules are redirects in Ansible 15
answer_card.answer_md:
In community.general (Ansible 15) the `keycloak_*` modules are redirects to `middleware_automation.keycloak`. Install that collection, or the redirects won't work:

```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install middleware_automation.keycloak
```

Then use the new FQCNs, for example `middleware_automation.keycloak.keycloak_client`.
